data.one_liner: Streamlined and extendable binary data creation and reading.
data.what_it_does: Binarize wraps ByteData functionality into a streamlined payload system for reading and writing binary data. It prevents manual byte offset calculations and supports custom payload types and strongly typed binary contracts for Dart classes.
use_when: You are implementing a binary file format specification.
You need to serialize and deserialize custom Dart objects into binary buffers efficiently.
avoid_when: You only need high-level text serialization like JSON.
You require complex state management or database storage.
strengths: Simplifies reading and writing with ByteData without manual offset tracking.
Supports custom payload types and strongly typed binary contracts.
weaknesses: Requires manual ordering of reads and writes to match the binary structure.
Niche use case limited to binary file formats and custom binary serialization.
